# `timeline`

Helper: `timeline({ date, title, detail, by, icon, tone }, ...)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaTile` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Vertical list; each item: round icon dot (32px) joined by a 2px line, date (micro, uppercase), title (600), detail, "by" line.

## Variants

- Dot tone: brand (default), success, warning, danger

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

brand-50, brand-100, brand-500, line, ink, ink-soft, success/warning/danger with -soft and -line

## Do

- Newest first or oldest first, one order per screen
- Name who did it in the "by" line

## Don't

- Do not use it for a form wizard

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Dot 32, connector at left 15.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Patient journey / history. Dot icon + connector line
